raw.text: # 电商商品图提示词合集 可以直接复制的商品图提示词：主图、场景图、广告创意、模特图、店铺海报。每条都配了它真实生成出来的图，先看效果再动手。 **共 11 条中文提示词**（均为文生图）· 更新于 2026-11-25 · 每周新增 > 英文提示词 9 条见 [English README](README.md)。 [许可](LICENSE) ## 怎么用 1. 挑一条，原样复制。 2. 把商品名称、颜色、材质换成你的；背景、光线和最后那句“不要文字 / 不要标志”保留。 3. 任何能写文字提示词的生图模型都能用（GPT Image、Nano Banana、即梦 / Seedream、Midjourney、Flux 等）。不同模型出图不同，示例图只代表一次真实结果。 ## 这些提示词的共同写法 - **先写商品、写明无品牌**：颜色、材质、件数说清楚。 - **再写背景与布景**：无缝浅灰背景、浅色石台、亚麻布。 - **写光线**：柔和棚拍光、侧逆光、暖色轮廓光。 - **写要看清的细节**：编织纹理、缝线、釉色变化、真实接触阴影。 - **写构图**：整件入镜、左侧留白放文案。 - **最后一句排除项**：不要人物、文字、标志、可识别的品牌设计。 ## 目录 - 01 商品主图（纯色 / 白底）（3 条）· [分类文件](prompts/01-clean-catalog.md) - 02 场景图与俯拍（1 条）· [分类文件](prompts/02-lifestyle.md) - 03 广告创意图（3 条）· [分类文件](prompts/03-ad-creative.md) - 04 多场景套图与节日礼盒（1 条）· [分类文件](prompts/04-mockup-holiday.md) - 05 模特图（1 条）· [分类文件](prompts/05-on-model.md) - 06 店铺海报（带中文字）（2 条）· [分类文件](prompts/07-shop-poster.md) ## 01 商品主图（纯色 / 白底） 列表主图：单个商品、无缝纯色背景、柔和均匀的光、真实的接触阴影。 ### 竹编收纳篮主图 ```text 原创电商商品摄影，一只无品牌的浅色竹编收纳篮放在米白无缝背景上，四分之三视角，完整展示篮口、提手和细密编织纹理，篮内只放一块折叠素色棉布，柔和棚拍光，真实接触阴影，画面干净。不要人物、文字、标签、品牌标志、水印或可识别的品牌专属造型。 ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`1:1` - 来源页预设模型：`gpt-image-2` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/product-photos` ### 手工茶壶细节图 ```text 原创商品摄影，一把无品牌的紫砂小茶壶放在浅灰石台上，壶盖正常合拢，壶嘴与把手完整入镜，侧后方柔光表现细腻砂粒和温润质感，背景为低饱和暖灰，不摆茶杯，不加装饰文字。不要人物、印章、款识、品牌标志、水印或知名器型的直接复制。 ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`3:4` - 来源页预设模型：`gpt-image-2` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/product-photos` ### 冰淇淋商品静物 ```text 极简静物商品图：银色勺子上一球粉色草莓冰淇淋，暖米色纯色背景，柔和侧光，浅景深，干净的电商风格 ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`3:4` - 来源页预设模型：`nano-banana-2` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/product-photos` ## 02 场景图与俯拍 把商品放进使用场景或布景里：俯拍、室内、氛围光。 ### 原木文具俯拍 ```text 原创电商俯拍图，一套无品牌原木文具整齐摆在暖白桌面上，包括木尺、无字封面的线装笔记本、素色铅笔和小号木笔筒，各物件之间留出清晰间隔，柔和窗光，真实木纹，克制的米棕配色。尺面不写数字，笔记本与铅笔不写字，不要人物、品牌标志或水印。 ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`4:3` - 来源页预设模型：`gpt-image-2` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/product-photos` ## 03 广告创意图 飞溅、爆炸图、风格化静物，用于广告和首屏横幅。 ### 气泡酒飞溅广告 ```text 苹果气泡酒商品广告：绿色玻璃瓶立在冰块和青苹果片中，酒液向四周飞溅，亮绿色背景，高速摄影质感，瓶身不出现文字 ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`9:16` - 来源页预设模型：`nano-banana-pro` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/product-photos` ### 口红甜品挞静物 ```text 复古静物广告：红格子桌布上一只樱桃甜品挞，两支红色口红插在奶油上，红丝带和樱桃散落，天蓝色背景，明亮硬光 ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`4:3` - 来源页预设模型：`nano-banana-2` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/product-photos` ### 折叠雨伞雨滴广告 ```text 原创商品广告，一把无品牌的深青色折叠雨伞完全撑开，伞柄朝下，完整悬置在浅蓝灰背景中央，伞面布料纹理清晰，少量晶莹雨滴附着，斜向柔光表现防雨质感，构图简洁可信，不做液体飞溅。不要人物、文字、品牌标志、复杂花纹或水印。 ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`3:4` - 来源页预设模型：`gpt-image-2` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/product-photos` ## 04 多场景套图与节日礼盒 一张图里出同一商品的多个场景，以及节日礼盒主图。 ### 中秋月饼礼盒主图 ```text 中秋月饼礼盒电商主图：深红礼盒配金色云纹，六个金黄月饼，切开一个看到莲蓉和咸蛋黄，背景圆月和桂花，金色书法“月满人团圆” ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`1:1` - 来源页预设模型：`nano-banana-2` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/product-photos` ## 05 模特图 美妆特写：模特手拿商品贴近镜头。 ### 水光肌美妆特写 ```text 美妆广告特写：短发女生手拿口红贴近嘴唇，皮肤水润有光泽，米白背景，柔和正面光，干净高级 ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`16:9` - 来源页预设模型：`nano-banana-2` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/product-photos` ## 06 店铺海报（带中文字） 画面里直接出标题文字的促销海报。 ### 新中式春茶海报 ```text 新中式茶饮海报：青瓷杯里的绿茶冒着热气，米色宣纸背景，几片茶叶和一枝梅花，书法大标题“春茶上新”，小字“明前绿茶 · 每日现泡”，红色印章点缀，大量留白 ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`3:4` - 来源页预设模型：`gpt-image-2` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/posters` ### 夏日冰粉新品海报 ```text 夏日甜品店新品海报：青花瓷碗里一份红糖冰粉，配山楂碎、葡萄干和花生碎，碗边冒着冷气，背景是竹帘和绿荷叶，大字“冰粉上新”，小字“一碗清凉 · 12 元”，清爽蓝绿配色 ``` - 类型：文生图 - 比例：`3:4` - 来源页预设模型：`gpt-image-2` - 来源：`image2ai.cloud/zh/templates/posters` ## 示例从哪来 本仓库所有示例图和提示词都取自 https://image2ai.cloud/zh/ 站上公开的示例（模板页、首页示例墙），提示词逐字照抄，没有改写，也没有为本仓库另外生成。“来源页预设模型”是来源页为这条提示词预填的模型。每张图的来源页、原图地址和 SHA-256 见 [data/sources.md](data/sources.md)。 ## 许可 提示词文字：CC0 1.0，随意复制改写。图片：见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

readme: # E-commerce Product Photo Prompts Copy-ready prompts for product photos — catalog shots, lifestyle scenes, ad creatives, and on-model shots. Every prompt comes with the image it actually produced, so you can see what to expect before you spend a credit. **9 prompts** · last updated 2026-11-25 · new prompts added weekly > 中文版 / Chinese version: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md) — 11 条中文提示词 (11 prompts in Chinese). [License](LICENSE) ## How to use 1. Pick a prompt below and copy it as is. 2. Change the product noun, colors and materials to match your item; keep the rest (background, light, the "no text / no logos" line). 3. Use it in any image model that takes text prompts (GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, Midjourney, Flux, ...). Results differ between models; the sample image shows one real output, not a guarantee. ## What these prompts have in common Most prompts here are built in the same order: - **Subject first, unbranded**: "a single unbranded rust-orange hiking backpack" — say what it is, its color and material. - **Setting and background**: "seamless light-gray background", "pale stone studio plinth", "ivory linen". - **Light**: "broad softbox lighting", "soft morning side light", "warm rim light". - **What to show clearly**: "visible stitching, straps and zipper pulls", "show glaze variation and believable contact shadows". - **Framing**: "keep the entire bag inside the frame", "empty space on the left for copy". - **A closing exclusion line**: "No people, labels, text, logos or recognizable branded design." ## Contents - [Clean catalog shots (plain or white background)](#01-clean-catalog-shots-plain-or-white-background) — 2 · [file](prompts/01-clean-catalog.md) - [Lifestyle scenes and flat lays](#02-lifestyle-scenes-and-flat-lays) — 3 · [file](prompts/02-lifestyle.md) - [Ad creatives](#03-ad-creatives) — 2 · [file](prompts/03-ad-creative.md) - [Mockup sets and holiday gift shots](#04-mockup-sets-and-holiday-gift-shots) — 1 · [file](prompts/04-mockup-holiday.md) - [On-model shots](#05-on-model-shots) — 1 · [file](prompts/05-on-model.md) ## 01 Clean catalog shots (plain or white background) Main listing images: one product, plain seamless background, soft even light, real contact shadow. ### Ceramic Bowl Collection ```text Create a clean catalog photograph of three original handmade ceramic bowls in chalk white, clay pink and moss green, arranged at different heights on a seamless light-gray background. Show glaze variation and believable contact shadows, crisp edges, broad softbox lighting. No food, people, text, logos or recognizable branded patterns. ``` - Type: text-to-image - Aspect ratio: `1:1` - Model preset on the source page: `gpt-image-2` - Source: `image2ai.cloud/templates/product-photos` ### Trail Backpack Detail ```text Photograph a single unbranded rust-orange hiking backpack standing on a pale stone studio plinth. Three-quarter view, believable woven fabric, visible stitching, straps and zipper pulls, soft directional light and a muted blue background. Keep the entire bag inside the frame. No people, labels, text, logos or recognizable branded design. ``` - Type: text-to-image - Aspect ratio: `3:4` - Model preset on the source page: `gpt-image-2` - Source: `image2ai.cloud/templates/product-photos` ## 02 Lifestyle scenes and flat lays Show the product in use or in a styled setting: flat lays, interiors, mood lighting. ### Handmade Soap Flat Lay ```text Create an original overhead product photograph of three unbranded handmade oat soap bars on ivory linen, with scattered oats and a small wooden tray. Show the cut texture clearly, soft morning side light, warm neutral colors, generous space between objects. No people, packaging text, logos, watermarks or recognizable branded shapes. ``` - Type: text-to-image - Aspect ratio: `1:1` - Model preset on the source page: `gpt-image-2` - Source: `image2ai.cloud/templates/product-photos` ### Sculptural Table Lamp ```text Create an original interior product photograph of an unbranded sculptural table lamp with a cream pleated shade and walnut base on a simple side table. Warm lamp glow against a cool dusk wall, realistic fabric and wood grain, restrained styling, empty space to the left. No people, lettering, logos or recognizable designer-product replicas. ``` - Type: text-to-image - Aspect ratio: `4:3` - Model preset on the source page: `gpt-image-2` - Source: `image2ai.cloud/templates/product-photos` ### Perfume on wet stones ```text Unbranded amber glass perfume bottle on wet black stones, gentle ripples, warm rim light and teal background glow, luxury ad look, empty space on the left for copy ``` - Type: text-to-image - Aspect ratio: `16:9` - Model preset on the source page: `nano-banana-pro` - Source: `image2ai.cloud/templates/product-photos` ## 03 Ad creatives Splash shots, exploded views and styled still lifes for ads and hero banners. ### Protein shake splash ad ```text Hyper-real product ad: a matte blue protein shake bottle labeled "PEAKLINE" leaning into a creamy milk splash with blueberries, condensation drops, studio light ``` - Type: text-to-image - Aspect ratio: `3:4` - Model preset on the source page: `gpt-image-2` - Source: `image2ai.cloud/templates/product-photos` ### Exploded headphones ```text Exploded view of unbranded over-ear headphones: ear cups, drivers, cushions, circuit board and screws floating in perfect alignment on a white seamless background ``` - Type: text-to-image - Aspect ratio: `1:1` - Model preset on the source page: `nano-banana-pro` - Source: `image2ai.cloud/templates/product-photos` ## 04 Mockup sets and holiday gift shots One product across several scenes in one image, and seasonal gift-box key visuals. ### Skincare mockup grid ```text 3x3 grid of designer mockups for one frosted sage-green dropper bottle labeled "VERDA": on stone, in water, with botanicals, in hand, flat lay ``` - Type: text-to-image - Aspect ratio: `3:4` - Model preset on the source page: `nano-banana-2` - Source: `image2ai.cloud/templates/product-photos` ## 05 On-model shots Beauty close-ups with a model holding the product. ### Lipstick beauty close-up ```text High-end beauty ad close-up: a model with wet-look short blonde hair and freckles holds a silver lipstick near her glossy lips, soft frontal light, off-white background ``` - Type: text-to-image - Aspect ratio: `16:9` - Model preset on the source page: `nano-banana-2` - Source: `image2ai.cloud/templates/product-photos` ## About the samples
